book.name: Lukas
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole na tuka Lukas susura na

content: Malaka nitu soba Ramatua Yesus
Yohanis sarani basa Yesus, boe ma Yesus laꞌo ela lee Yarden a. Manetualain Dula-dale Malalao-malalafu Na sama-sama no Ni. Basa boe ma Dula-daleꞌ ria noon leo mamana lino-nes a neu.
Yesus leo nai na losa faiꞌ haa hulu. Tepoꞌ ria ta naa-ninu hata esa boeꞌ, losa Ana namalaa naan seli. Boe ma malaka nitu mai soba Ni.
Ana nafada Yesus nae, “Kalu tetebes ara O ia nana Manetualain Anan, O manuu kuasa. De, bisa mafada batu ia ra dadi roti, fo mua.”
Tehuu Yesus nataa ni nae, “O ta mae tao boeꞌ ma! Ta bubuluꞌ fa do? Mana duiꞌ nai Susura Makamoiꞌ daleꞌ nae,

content.text: ‘Lahenda dae-bafoꞌ a nasoda, nana ta noi neme nanaa-nininuꞌ a mai fa.’ ”

content: Basa boe ma malaka nitu a noo Yesus leo mamana madema esa neu, de natudu Ni basa mane dae-bafoꞌ a nusa-namon. Ana nafada Yesus nae, “Basa kuasa sira ro marela-masaꞌan nana au nuu ki. De, au anuu hak ae fee bea boe neme au hihii ka mai.
Au nau fee O katemaꞌ asa. Tehuu O muste tao hihii-nanauꞌ esa dei, besaꞌ ko au fee. Mudaꞌ lai esaꞌ! O doꞌo-tabe neuꞌ au. Noi ri naꞌ so!”
Tehuu Yesus nataa ni nae, “Hapun nai bea leo naꞌ? Huu fo mana duiꞌ nai Susura Makamoiꞌ daleꞌ nae,

Basa ria, boe ma malaka nitu noo Yesus leo kota Yerusalem a neu. Nai na, ana noo Yesus leo Uma Mamaso Ina a puni na lain neu. Boe ma ana nae, “Maneniko tebe-tebe O nana Manetualain Anan, sona parbokuꞌ daeꞌ mu leo!
Huu fo mana duiꞌ nai Susura Makamoiꞌ daleꞌ nae,

content.text: ‘Manetualain neuꞌ ko nadenu eilaꞌo-limalopen reme nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a mai,
Neuꞌ ko ara ratanee ra O,
fo ela O ei ma ta tetaꞌ laꞌe batu ria baiꞌ boeꞌ.’ ”

content: Tehuu Yesus nataa ni nae, “Mana duiꞌ nai Susura Makamoiꞌ daleꞌ nae,
Malaka nitu soba Yesus neniꞌ eno rupaꞌ ara, tehuu ta nala Ni fa. Basa boe ma ana foa ela Yesus, fo nahani ledo-fai malole.
Ramatua Yesus leo Galilea neu fo mulai nafada lahenda ra laꞌeneuꞌ Manetualain Tutui Malole Na
Huu no Manetualain Dula-dale Malalao-malalafu Na kuasan, boe ma Yesus fali leo propinsi Galilea neu. Ta doo bea boeꞌ te, Yesus nade Na tui-bekan rule-feo nusaꞌ ria, de lahenda ra bubuluꞌ.
Ana nanori-nafada nai lahenda Yahudi ra uma mamaso nara katemaꞌ. Boe ma ara io Ni rae, “Yesus nana Mana kuasa!”
Lahenda ra ta sipoꞌ Ramatua Yesus nai Nasaret

Laiꞌ esa de, Yesus leo koro Nasaret na mai. Laꞌe fai lahenda Yahudi ra fai huhule-haradoin, riꞌ ‘fai Sabat’, Ana leo uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ neu, sama leoꞌ Ria biasa na. Basa de Ana foa napadeiꞌ fo nau lees neme Manetualain Susura Makamoiꞌ na mai.
Boe ma ara fee Ni baꞌi Yesaya dudui na. Ana buka ni, de lees nai lalaneꞌ fo mana duiꞌ nae,

content.text: Manetualain Dula-dale Na kuasa Na nai Au.
Huu ria na Ana tudu na Au,
fo tui-beka Manetualain Tutui Malole Na neuꞌ lahenda manatoꞌa-manataꞌ ara.
neuꞌ ko poꞌi mana hukuꞌ ara;
neuꞌ ko pokeꞌ ara rita dae;
neuꞌ ko poꞌi mana hapu eese-rurumuꞌ ara.
Ma besaꞌ ia losa Ramatuaꞌ ledo-fain,

content: Yesus lees basa duduiꞌ ria, boe ma lulu faliꞌ ana de loo ni leo mana tao mamasoꞌ a neu, boe ma Ana natuuꞌ. Basa lahenda fo rai uma mamasoꞌ ria daleꞌ mete rahere Ni.
Boe ma Ana nafada si nae, “Hata fo bisinaꞌ a emi mamanene ni neme Susura Makamoiꞌ a mai a, besaꞌ ia dadi so!”
Basa lahenda fo rai na, mulai io Yesus rae, “Ae! Hata fo bisinaꞌ a Ana dedea ni a, malole na seli! Tehuu Ria nana, Yusuf anan, hete? Ubeaꞌ taon de bisa leo naꞌ?”

Boe ma Yesus nafada si nae, “Tantu emi basa moi taoꞌ Au meniꞌ dedeaꞌ lasiꞌ a nae, ‘Dokter! Puli-mamodo ma ao-ina heheli ma dei! Ubeaꞌ taon de O ta tao tanda heran esa fee ami nai ia boeꞌ, sama leoꞌ O tao nai kota Kapernaum a?’
Matetu na leo iaꞌ: lahenda ta nau sipoꞌ Manetualain mana nesi matan nai ria koro-tadun fa.

Hai natutuduꞌ neme Manetualain mana nesi matan, baꞌi Elia. Laiꞌ esa de uda a ta mai fa teuꞌ telu seseriꞌ. Tepoꞌ ria ina-falu dodouꞌ rai Israel. Tehuu Manetualain ta fee Elia neu tulu-fali lahenda Israel ara. Manetualain fee ni leo ina-falu esa neu, nai koro Sarfat naneneaꞌ kota Sidon. Sekonaa te inaꞌ ria, lahenda ta Yahudi fa. Tehuu ana namahere neuꞌ Manetualain kuasa Na.

Hai natutuduꞌ fekeꞌ neme Manetualain mana nesi matan Elisa mai. Tepoꞌ ria, lahenda Yahudi dodouꞌ ramahedi hedi kusta rai Israel. Tehuu Manetualain ta puli na si fa. Ana nadenu noi Elisa puli na lahenda kamahedi kusta esa, nade Naaman. Sekonaa te, ria nana lahenda Siria, ta Yahudi fa. Tehuu ana namahere neuꞌ Manetualain kuasa Na.”
Bei ramanene Yesus dedea nae leoꞌ na, boe ma basa si nasa nara lua.
Boe ma ara foa belaꞌ a, de usi heni Ni neme uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ mai. Tutiꞌ a hela roo Ni leo koroꞌ a suu-dea neu, fo nau ruan leo pere daleꞌ neu.
Tehuu Ana kalua laꞌo nesiꞌ lahenda kadodouꞌ sira talada, de foa ela si reuꞌ na.
Ramatua Yesus usi heni nitu neme lahenda esa mai
Basa ria, boe ma Yesus onda leo Kapernaum neu, nai dano Galilea a suu na. Tuka-tuka fai huhule-haradoiꞌ, Ana nanori lahenda rai uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ.
Lahenda ra roi ramakokoaꞌ a ramanene dedea-nafada Ni, huu fo Ana bubuluꞌ matetuꞌ nanoriꞌ ria isi na.
Laiꞌ esa de, Yesus nanori nai uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ, hapu lahenda nitu hekeꞌ esa mulai naloo namberaina nae,
“Ae! Yesus, Lahenda Nasaret! O nau tao ubeaꞌ mo ami! O nau mai tao malulutuꞌ ami, do? Ami malelaꞌ O, nana Lahenda Malalao-malalafuꞌ fo fai a ulu na Manetualain helu nae fee Ni mai.”
Tehuu Yesus nasapaa ni nae, “Maꞌauꞌ bafa ma! Kalua meme lahenda ria mai!” Kekeneu te nitu a lokopiro lahenda ria neuꞌ daeꞌ, nai lahenda ra talada. Basa boe ma ana foa ela ni, ma ta nahehediꞌ ana soꞌ.
Basa lahenda ra roi ramakokoaꞌ a rae, “Heran lai esaꞌ! Lahenda ia dedea Na, nanuu kuasa bauinaꞌ! Losaꞌ nitu ra biin, de kalua reme lahenda ria mai!”
Boe ma tutuiꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ Yesus, mulai tui-bekan nai nusaꞌ ria katemaꞌ.
Ramatua Yesus puli na Simon arinan, ma lahenda dodouꞌ bali
Faiꞌ fo ara kalua reme uma mamasoꞌ ria mai, boe ma Yesus leo Simon uma na neu.
Simon arina na namahedi ao luumaiꞌ a, de ao-ina na nanaa na seli. Boe ma ara hule Yesus rae, “Ramatuaꞌ! Puli ma ina lasiꞌ a dei!”
Yesus neu de napadei neuꞌ koi a suu na, boe ma usi heni ina lasiꞌ a ao luumai na. Hatemataꞌ ria boe, inaꞌ a ao luumai na mopoꞌ ana. Boe ma ana foa, de neu sadia nanaaꞌ fee si.
Ledo a sakaꞌ tena, boe ma lahenda ra roo basa kamahedis ara leo Yesus reu. Hedi nara rupaꞌ ara. Boe ma Ana fua lima Na neuꞌ lahenda kamahedis ara de puli na katemaꞌ asa.

Lahenda kamahedis sira, ruma nitu hekeꞌ ara. De, Yesus pareta nitu ra fo kalua remeꞌ lahenda sira mai. Ara kalua ma bobouꞌ rae, “O nana Manetualain Anan!” Huu fo nitu sira bubuluꞌ rae, Ria nana Kristus, fo neme fai a ulu na mai Manetualain helu nae fee Ni mai. Huu ria na, Yesus nasaꞌai si fo ta bole dedea hata esa laꞌeneuꞌ Ao-ina Na boeꞌ.
Ramatua Yesus neu tui-beka Tutui Malole nai uma mamasoꞌ ara

Balahaꞌ dulupila na, boe ma Yesus foa de leo mamana lino-nees esa neu, nai kota a deaꞌ. Lahenda ra saka raleleiꞌ Ana. Ara raneta ron, boe ma leleꞌo Ni rae, “Papa leo mo ami! Bosoꞌ leo mamana fekeꞌ mu bali!”
Tehuu Ana sipoꞌ asa nae, “Au muste leo koro fekeꞌ ara uu, fo tui-beka Tutui Malole laꞌeneuꞌ Manetualain pareta Na. Huu fo Manetualain nadenu Au uu alalaꞌo nonoi lakaꞌ ria.”
Boe ma Ana laꞌo neme koroꞌ esa mai leo koroꞌ esa neu, fo nanori-nafada nai uma mamasoꞌ ara nai propinsi Yudea.

footnotes.text: Lalaneꞌ ia ra dua natetu no dudui dedea Yunani teaꞌ a. Susura Makamoiꞌ dedea Indonesia, tao lalane kasanahulu sio na neuꞌ mamanaꞌ fo ta naraa fa.
Simon nana, riꞌ Petrus nade feke na.
